gloss: full of energy; full of life; bursting with vitality

definitions.gloss: full of energy; full of life; bursting with vitality
definitions.explanation: Describes a state of being very lively, healthy, and energetic. Often used to describe children, animals, or anyone showing high spirits.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{元気|げんき}いっぱいだ。
examples.english: The children are full of energy.

examples.japanese: {元気|げんき}いっぱい⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいる→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: They are playing with great energy.

examples.japanese: {朝|あさ}ごはん⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しっかり→しっかり：01272_shikkari⟧⟦{食|た}べて→食べる：00396_taberu⟧、{元気|げんき}いっぱいで⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: After eating a proper breakfast, they went to school full of energy.

notes:
A set phrase combining ⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧ ('energy, health, vigor') with いっぱい ('full of'). It has a warm, positive tone and is especially common when talking about children, pets, or cheerful atmospheres. Can be used as a predicate ({元気|げんき}いっぱいだ) or as an adverb ({元気|げんき}いっぱい⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧).

USAGE:
As a predicate: {子|こ}どもたち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{元気|げんき}いっぱいだ (the children are full of energy).
As an adverbial modifier: {元気|げんき}いっぱい⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{走|はし}り{回|まわ}る→走り回る：04608_hashirimawaru⟧ (to run around full of energy).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧はつらつ: brimming with energy — slightly more formal, often used in advertising
- ⟦{生|い}き{生|い}き→生き生き：10223_ikiiki⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧: lively, vibrant — describes liveliness in a broader sense
- ピンピン⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧: hale and hearty — emphasizes physical health, especially of elderly people
